Container.Name: SecureOne
Container.Overview: Sign-in, single sign-on, MFA, users, roles and permissions for every application. Needs a PostgreSQL 16 and a Redis container (install both from Community Apps first), and an https address in front of the port (for example a reverse proxy). Then open the public address + /admin/setup.
Container.Requires: PostgreSQL 16 and Redis containers, reachable from this one.

Config.Name: Port
Config.Description: Web interface and sign-in (put your https reverse proxy in front of it)

Config.Name: Public address
Config.Description: The address people will use, for example https://id.example.com

Config.Name: Encryption key
Config.Description: Run: openssl rand -base64 32 in the Unraid terminal and paste the result. Keep a copy: without it, a database backup cannot be used.

Config.Name: Trusted proxies
Config.Description: Your reverse proxy's address (for example 172.17.0.0/16), so SecureOne sees each visitor's own address
